title: Combining Latest Values: combineLatest and withLatestFrom

questions.prompt: When does `combineLatest([a$, b$])` emit its FIRST value?

options.text: After both a$ and b$ have each emitted at least once
As soon as either a$ or b$ emits
Only when both a$ and b$ complete
Immediately on subscription, before any source emits

questions.explanation: combineLatest waits until every source has produced at least one value, then emits the latest of each and re-emits on any subsequent change.

options.text: It emits only when source$ emits, attaching the latest value of other$
It emits whenever either source$ or other$ emits
It emits only when other$ emits
It pairs source$ and other$ values by index

questions.explanation: withLatestFrom is driven by the primary (piped) source; it samples the latest of the secondaries on each primary emission and ignores changes to the secondaries alone.

questions.prompt: One of the sources passed to combineLatest never emits. What is the effect on the output?

options.text: combineLatest emits nothing at all, because it waits for every source
It emits using undefined for the silent source
It ignores the silent source entirely
It errors immediately

questions.explanation: A single silent source blocks all output. Seed such sources with startWith (or use a BehaviorSubject) so they have an initial value.

questions.prompt: Which call form of combineLatest is deprecated in RxJS 7?

options.text: The spread form combineLatest(a$, b$)
The array form combineLatest([a$, b$])
The object form combineLatest({ a: a$, b: b$ })
All forms are deprecated

questions.explanation: The spread (multiple-argument) form is deprecated. Use the array or object form in RxJS 7.

questions.prompt: To make a possibly-silent source emit an initial value so combineLatest can produce output, pipe it through which operator? Type its name.
questions.explanation: startWith(seed) prepends an immediate value, so combineLatest doesn't stall waiting for that source's first real emission.

questions.prompt: You want to react ONLY when a submit button is clicked, using the current form value. Which operator is correct?

options.text: withLatestFrom
combineLatest
zip
mergeMap

questions.explanation: withLatestFrom emits only on the primary (submit) event and samples the latest form value. combineLatest would over-emit, re-firing every time the form changes.
